notes.title: Speed Dating for Ghosts Expansion Just Around the Corner
notes.content:
The long-teased free expansion to Speed Dating for Ghosts is nearing completion. Finally, I know. It'll be out when you least expect it!

Here are some key updates/additions:

- an honest-to-goodness pause function
- the game now lets you know when it saves your progress
- improved controller support
- improved graveyard functionality

oh, and...

- four new ghosts to meet, making good on the promise of the trading cards and teaser trailer on this page
- closure

Watch this space. The next update will be when the expansion goes live! And in the meantime, in honor of Halloween, the game is cheaper than a king size chocolate bar.

If you're reading this, you probably already own our game. But maybe it would make a nice gift for that special friend who would enjoy weird stuff like this.

Thanks for your support and patience. More is coming. Sleep be damned.

👁 ❤ 👻,
Ben

notes.title: Teeny Tiny Expansion Update
notes.content:
Hey all. 

Just a quick update regarding the Speed Dating for Ghosts expansion. 

Personal circumstances slowed work on it, but it's getting done, dang it. I'm hiding in a hole until it's finished. Then it should appear in your games via update like a ghost in the corner of the room, wavin' hello.

More specific news soon and thanks for your patience!

👁 ❤ 👻, 
Ben

notes.title: Introducing the Eerie Indies Bundle
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/8890/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31156685/c9319c1f06b7aae03a984c946bf143bee266f3dc.png[/img][/url]

Beginning today, you can purchase [i]Speed Dating for Ghosts[/i] as part of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/8890/]a scary good Steam bundle[/url] that also includes:

[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/534550/Guacamelee_2/] [i]Guacamelee! 2[/i][/url]: Wrestle your way through the worlds of the living and the dead.
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/718670/Cultist_Simulator/][i]Cultist Simulator[/i][/url]: Grow a cult in a cunning narrative card game.
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/388880/Oxenfree/][i]Oxenfree[/i][/url]: Investigate a spooky island and learn its haunting secrets.
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/578720/A_Morticians_Tale/][i]A Mortician's Tale[/i][/url]: Prepare bodies and learn what life's like as a mortician.
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/626660/Flipping_Death/][i]Flipping Death[/i][/url]: Temp for Death to possess the living and aid the dead.
[/list]

Look at all these spooky stories! Buying the bundle gets you 20% off all of 'em. And if you already have some, you can take 20% off any remaining games! 

Halloween is a particularly good time to take advantage of this, as many of these eerie indies have additional sales going... including our game!

[i]Speed Dating for Ghosts[/I] is 50% off until November 1. When you take into account the added discount with the bundle, well... Halloween is basically Christmas this year. 

Leon in particular is thrilled.

If you've already purchased our game, thank you so dang much! It's helping me keep the momentum going for future projects.

As additional thanks, Mikey and I are also cooking up a significant update to the game. More on that soon though. 

Happy Dang Halloween!

👁 ❤ 👻, 
Ben

notes.title: Update: v 1.17 live
notes.content:
I've pushed an update to Speed Dating for Ghosts that fixes and polishes a bunch of things. Please update to get the full ghost dating experience with these fixes:

- A conditional issue has been fixed that was preventing players from seeing full reactivity to rejecting or being rejected by all nine ghosts in a single playthrough. On Steam, this also prevented people from earning the All Dressed Up and Nowhere to Ghost achievement.

- Steph no longer lingers unnaturally long at the end of her date if you tell her "You're dead." She also now makes a noise when she gets mad.

- The "Choose Your Date" images have been updated to better reflect the appearance of the ghosts and the room themes.

- Various minor fixes have been implemented to improve the flow of the text. We also caught a few typos!

Thanks for playing our game. We are thrilled with the spirited reaction to our game.

👁 ❤ 👻,
Ben

notes.title: Update: v 1.16 live
notes.content:
​Thank you all for playing on launch day. A few small bugs have emerged because that's just how the early days go. We've updated to fix all known issues.

v 1.16 fixes the dramatic reveal at the end of Steph's date and a couple lines in Riley's date that mix up Phantoms and Demons (how did that happen?)

If you find any bugs, please let us know in the discussion forum.

And thanks for playing!

👁 ❤ 👻,
Ben

notes.title: Speed Dating for Ghosts Launches on Valentine's Day
notes.content:
We finally have a date for the, um, ghost dates!

*drum roll*

Valentine’s Day!

Speed Dating for Ghosts will be released on Steam and elsewhere this upcoming February 14: the scariest day of the year!

In advance of this decision, gave ourselves two options: 

1. Push hard to release in early December, only to get swallowed up by all the great sales, giant releases, and best of lists.

2. Take some time to polish and refine things before releasing on Valentine's Day, a holiday already devoted to all things insubstantial and terrifying.

Since Halloween came and went, the latter seemed like the better option by far. So it's what we're gonna do!

We've even changed the release date on Steam, so it no longer says "When the Time Has Come"... or "When the Tim..." in search results.

Thanks for all the support so far. We'll be providing regular updates in the coming weeks.

Mostly we just can't wait for you all to meet some weird ghost friends.

👁 ❤ 👻,
Ben
